verdict.rationale: Bolna documents an official MCP server that connects Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, or any MCP client to a user's Bolna account over the Model Context Protocol, and a probe confirms the dedicated docs page exists. Missing for 10: detail on which tools and operations the MCP server exposes and its auth/setup depth, plus independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, or any MCP client to your Bolna account with the Bolna MCP server.
